title: myrceugenia pallida
intro: Myrceugenia pallida, commonly known as Chilean guava, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrceugenia pallida include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
